title: Mouse Without Borders broken on .102 release

judgment.rationale: The rollback is useful regression evidence, but key-generation failure points to a local pairing-management boundary before firewall hypotheses. Distinguish the generated-key UI/worker failure from a later network connection failure. Do not prescribe weakening peer checks or regenerating all machines' keys before collecting the first local error.
evidence: The Store-installed report explicitly says both pairing and Generate new key fail on 0.102, and that downgrading to 0.101 restores operation.
No exact error, failing key-action result, diagnostic archive, or service-mode state is supplied; this is broader than a network-only pairing failure.

actions.label: Capture the failed MWB Generate new key operation

comment.body:
The 0.102 → 0.101 rollback is useful; no need to repeat it. Because Generate new key also fails, this may occur before any network pairing. Could you please:
- Click Generate new key once on the failing 0.102 installation, say whether it is disabled, shows an error, or leaves the displayed value unchanged, and note whether Use service is on. Do not share the key.
- Immediately after that attempt, comment /bugreport and attach the resulting report. If Settings or the tray is unavailable, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory. The report should establish the exact patch version and first local failure without another generic firewall checklist.
